title: Adds support for Data Share Only for 3D Secure authentication
changed: data_share_only added to three_d_secure.result on Charge, SetupAttempt and Payment Records; Charges now include three_d_secure for Data Share Only transactions
reason: charge.payment_method_details (and card.three_d_secure) is a nullable `anyOf` reference in the recorded contracts, and the analyzer resolves nested schemas only through direct `$ref`s (analyzer.ts referencedPropertySchema), so reads and switches below it are not traced: nothing is reported, with or without fullDiff. The new three_d_secure presence is a behaviour change with no contract difference.
